singlePurpose: An independent, user-operated workspace for managing Alibaba.com international products, image and video assets, RFQs, trade and logistics through documented APIs, including publishing a selected gallery image to the user's connected business social account.

permissions.justification: Stores user-entered gateway credentials encrypted with a user passphrase, local settings and onboarding state, durable product mutation status without secrets or full responses, and an optional 30-day scoped device token for a user-controlled social publishing BFF. Derived unlock material and redacted diagnostics are held only in current Chrome-session memory. The passphrase is never stored, local/session storage is hidden from content scripts, and session unlock material is cleared by browser restart, extension update/reload, explicit locking, or the configured idle timeout. Optional S3 configuration uses separate AES-GCM ciphertext in local storage and a non-exportable device key in local IndexedDB, with no additional password. Clearing S3 configuration removes both. Video upload receipts and recovery metadata use separate local IndexedDB without file bytes, Base64, source or signed URLs, or credentials. New product/RFQ edits stay in page memory; legacy edit drafts are neither restored nor automatically deleted.

Runs fixed packaged code only in the known Alibaba Application Center and OAuth tabs after the user explicitly starts credential acquisition. It does not execute remote code, collect the website password, accept agreements, or bypass human verification.
Sends user-initiated, signed HTTPS requests to the documented Alibaba.com Open Platform gateway.

Chrome grants only the specific host requested when a user starts credential acquisition, confirms the actual OAuth callback, configures a custom gateway or S3-compatible asset storage, pairs a user-controlled social publishing BFF, or explicitly transfers an external image. S3 requests, including video multipart staging, use the existing grant for the configured storage host and are signed in the extension background. Grants are revocable in settings; video upload adds no Manifest permission or permanent host grant.
